desc: Finalize algorithm design: PST over B-index for O(log V) g(a,Y) queries + numpy H-table (BA=1000, ~80MB) for block-boundary answers + PST for remainder elements

Implement solution: input parsing, coordinate compression, PST build (N+1 versions, count+sum), numpy H-table build via searchsorted per A-block, cumsum over j, query loop (table lookup + ≤BA PST queries), fast output
Test on provided samples and random brute-force cross-checks (small N,K) to validate correctness — both samples and ~200 randomized tests pass
Optimize: replace PST remainder queries with offline Y-sorted sweep + Fenwick over B values (removes PST memory ~150-380MB and cuts query time); keep numpy H-table for block boundaries
Re-validate correctness (samples + brute force) and measure timing/memory on max-size input (N=1e5, K=1e4); finalize code

If max-size run is too slow or MLEs: tune BA (e.g. 500-1200, trading numpy memory vs request count), drop the separate H table (keep only cumsum PH), or batch/vectorize request answering (sort requests by value + pointer sweep instead of per-request binary search)
